purpose: Expand independent per-option guitaristic component supervision and measure blind intra-rater reliability before any component-model training or Guitaristic Arbiter design.

parent_evidence.s0c_finding: The single global A/B naturalness target failed the frozen repeat-reliability gate: 34/60 exact semantic agreement and Cohen kappa 0.1333.
parent_evidence.s0da_finding: Five repeated pairwise subquestions were perfectly collinear on 20/20 tasks and therefore did not create independent component supervision.
parent_evidence.s0db_finding: Independent per-option 1-5 scoring produced component separation on 13/20 tasks; OPEN_STRING_UTILITY was the most distinct component while position/string/finger remained strongly coupled.
parent_evidence.architecture_consequence: Do not train component specialists until the decomposed rubric itself demonstrates high repeat reliability on a larger sealed corpus.

first_pass_component_corpus.selection: Target-blind deterministic SHA256 ranking within curriculum level after frozen exclusions. Fill levels in fixed round-robin order while respecting the family cap; no Teacher score or historical preference may influence selection.

family_cv_folds.assignment: Sort distinct selected family IDs by SHA256(family_id|stage7g-e3-s1a-family-fold-v1), then assign round-robin to folds 0..4. All tasks from one family remain in one fold.
family_cv_folds.note: These folds reserve family-isolated development evaluation structure only. They do not authorize training in S1-A.

elicitation.option_isolation: Score A alone, lock its four component scores, then score B alone and lock its four component scores. Only after both options are scored may A and B be shown together for overall preference.

fatigue_control.session_assignment: Deterministic from the sealed task order; no result-driven reassignment.

POSITION_COMFORT.1: very awkward or practically unusable hand position
POSITION_COMFORT.rule_tr: Perde numarasını tek başına ceza sayma. Yüksek pozisyon kendi içinde rahat ve düzenli olabilir.

STRING_DISTRIBUTION.1: very unnatural string distribution or severe crossing/skipping burden
STRING_DISTRIBUTION.rule_tr: Garip tel atlaması, çaprazlama veya gereksiz tel değişimini dezavantaj say.

FINGER_SPREAD.1: extreme or clearly uncomfortable spread/hand shape
FINGER_SPREAD.rule_tr: Yalnız parmak açıklığı ve el şekline odaklan; pozisyon yüksekliğini tek başına ceza sayma.

OPEN_STRING_UTILITY.1: open-string use is clearly harmful/awkward for this shape
OPEN_STRING_UTILITY.3: neutral or no meaningful open-string advantage; use 3 when the option has no open strings
OPEN_STRING_UTILITY.5: clear ergonomic/resonance/economy advantage from open strings
OPEN_STRING_UTILITY.rule_tr: Açık tel otomatik olarak iyi değildir. Açık tel yoksa 3 = nötr kullan.

blind_repeat_reliability.repeat_selection: Select from the sealed 120 first-pass tasks before any first-pass Teacher response is opened, using only task identity/curriculum/family metadata and deterministic SHA256 ranking.

primary_component_reliability_gate.unit: paired option-level rating; 48 repeat tasks produce 96 paired ratings per component
primary_component_reliability_gate.meaning: Passing opens design of a separate component-model training protocol only. It does not train, retain, or activate any model.

secondary_overall_preference_reliability.meaning: This secondary gate does not control component-model eligibility. A failure keeps direct overall-preference/arbiter supervision closed even if component reliability passes.

before_training_only: per-component exact / within-one / mean-absolute-difference repeat metrics
repeat reliability by family without changing thresholds
overall-preference exact repeat agreement and three-way Cohen kappa
A-minus-B component deltas versus overall preference as descriptive evidence only

forbidden: changing task quotas or reliability thresholds after responses are observed
using historical overall Teacher preference to select S1-A tasks
using repeat responses as additional training examples
